origin.description: The default follows useFancyQuotes, which is TRUE on this UTF-8 machine, so the quotes are curly.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: TRUE, TeX, UTF-8, a four-string vector, or None for straight quotes.

origin.details: q TRUE or UTF-8 uses U+201C and U+201D. TeX uses backticks and apostrophes. A character vector of length four or more supplies the quotes at positions 3 and 4. NULL q keeps straight quotes.
origin.example:
bp_dQuote <- getFromNamespace("dQuote", "backports")
print(bp_dQuote("foo"))
print(bp_dQuote("foo", q = TRUE))
print(bp_dQuote("foo", q = "TeX"))
